Guides.Title: 巨龙战吼成长
Guides.Summary: 用四本诗人站稳场面，碰出卡雷苟斯后转入战吼成长，并在五本继续碰六本核心。
Guides.EnglishSummary: Stabilize with Tier 4 Dragons, Triple into Kalecgos, then upgrade and Triple into the Tier 6 core.

EntryProfiles.Title: 简单模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 直观看到战吼成长巨龙的完整七格阵容。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Inspect the completed seven-slot Dragon Battlecry board.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 依次打出手牌中的四张巨龙并调整站位
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play the four finishing Dragons from hand and set their board order

OfferSchedules.Label: 引导刷新：必含卡雷苟斯
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Guided refresh: Kalecgos is included

EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 四本碰五本核心，保留三个巨龙过大饰品门槛，再升五本碰六本核心。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Triple from Tier 4 to the Tier 5 core, keep three Dragons for the Greater Trinket, then upgrade and Triple into Tier 6.
